# Loan Contract Management Directives

This document outlines critical actions required for the effective management of loan contracts and associated risks.

*   Optimize the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Update the borrower credit score quarterly.
*   Monitor the default risk quarterly.
*   Investigate the collateral value standard update.
